name: Spotless Mobile App
alt_id: Tangkapan layar proyek Spotless Mobile App
desc_id: Aplikasi mobile cuci mobil premium yang dibayangkan ulang dari Karcher. React 19 + TypeScript, terasa native — 30+ layar: onboarding, pencarian merchant dengan peta, booking dengan add-on, dompet token, QR, dan 10 metode pembayaran.
desc_en: A premium car wash mobile app reimagined from Karcher. React 19 + TypeScript, native in feel — 30+ screens: onboarding, merchant search with maps, booking with add-ons, token wallet, QR, and 10 payment methods.
